text: Welcome, Your Majesty! I’m Hale, your helper. Let me show you how to rule Riverstone.
These are your four meters: Food, Gold, Happiness and Safety. If any one of them reaches 0, your reign ends!
Your reign lasts 6 years. Each dot is one visitor. Reach the last dot to win!
Here comes a villager. Read what they are asking for.
Each answer shows what it will do. An up arrow means that meter goes up. A down arrow means it goes down.
Your turn! Drag the card right for yes, or left for no. You can press a button too.
Look at your meters! Every choice helps something, and most cost something too.
Every third visitor asks a maths question. A right answer gives plus 2 to a meter. That’s it. Rule well!
Drag the card right to say yes, or left to say no. You can press the buttons too.
Before you choose, look at the arrows on the meters. an up arrow goes up, a down arrow goes down.
Every third visitor needs help with a maths question. A right answer gives plus 2!
Food is getting low! If it reaches 0, your reign ends. Look for choices with an up arrow on Food.
Gold is getting low! If it reaches 0, your reign ends. Look for choices with an up arrow on Gold.
Happiness is getting low! If it reaches 0, your reign ends. Look for choices with an up arrow on Happiness.
Safety is getting low! If it reaches 0, your reign ends. Look for choices with an up arrow on Safety.
